name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover water damage from a dripping ceiling?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover water damage from a dripping ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowner's insurance typically covers sudden and accidental water damage, such as a burst pipe or a storm-damaged roof leading to a ceiling leak. However, policies usually do not cover damage resulting from neglect, poor maintenance, or long-term, slow leaks that could have been prevented. It's essential to review your specific policy details or contact your insurance provider directly to understand your coverage. A professional restoration company can often assist with documentation and working with your insurance claim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowner's insurance often covers sudden water damage, but typically not damage from neglected maintenance or long-term leaks. Check your specific policy for details.
